mapper.select: SELECT request_id, request_hash, adjustment_status AS status, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id) AS applied_count, MAX(applied_at) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id) AS applied_at FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY inventory_demo_adjustment_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND requested_at >= #{since} AND adjustment_status = 'APPLIED'
SELECT MAX(applied_at) FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND adjustment_status = 'APPLIED'
SELECT 1 FROM inventory_source_state WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT available_stock_count AS on_hand_qty, reserved_stock_count AS reserved_qty, row_version, record_hash, synced_record_hash FROM inventory_source_offline WHERE source_record_key = #{sourceRecordKey} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT sellable_quantity AS on_hand_qty, ordered_quantity AS reserved_qty, row_version, record_hash, synced_record_hash FROM inventory_source_ecommerce WHERE source_record_key = #{sourceRecordKey} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT saleable_meal_count AS on_hand_qty, committed_meal_count AS reserved_qty, row_version, record_hash, synced_record_hash FROM inventory_source_greeting WHERE source_record_key = #{sourceRecordKey} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
choose.otherwise: SELECT physical_available_qty AS on_hand_qty, physical_reserved_qty AS reserved_qty, row_version, record_hash, synced_record_hash FROM inventory_source_warehouse WHERE source_record_key = #{sourceRecordKey} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_source_state SET pending_record_count = pending_record_count + CASE WHEN #{wasSynced} = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, current_version = current_version + 1, last_changed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE source_type = #{sourceType}
